name: islambouli-letters-lock
rule: A row changes ONLY to correct a transcription error proved against the witness image, through a new version whose reason names the row and the evidence. A row never changes because a root reads badly: that would stop citing Islambouli.

history.reason: First freeze: the transcription of the poster's 29 rows, each re-read at 3× on the original image, before any uses of the second holdout were written.

source.witness_origin: supplied by the user, origin unrecorded
source.witness_history: A truncated first deposit (ending at row 28, showing neither book nor author) was replaced by this original before any row was transcribed.

witness_imprint.reading_note: Set with kashida stretching (دلالـة أصـوات الأحـرف العربيـة); the image cannot show whether that is typed tatweel or justification, so it is not transcribed.
